title: Two arrested in West Kalimantan over alleged bride trafficking to China
html:
The case came to light on Oct 21, after police received information from local residents.

PHOTO: LIANHE ZAOBAO

AI generated

JAKARTA – Two people have been arrested in West Kalimantan for allegedly operating a bride-trafficking scheme, recruiting Indonesian women for marriages to men in China.

West Kalimantan Police’s Women and Children Protection and Anti-Human Trafficking Directorate chief, Senior Commissioner Rusdiani, said the two suspects, identified only as L, 42, and LKS, 36, were both homemakers who had allegedly arranged four such marriages.
summary: Police said both suspects were homemakers who had allegedly arranged four cross-border marriages.
